sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: In the Dualist period the Hungarian Parliament saw sharp debates. The opposition used *obstrukció* (delaying a vote with long speeches and procedural motions) to hold up legislation; stories of reading unrelated texts from the rostrum are anecdotal.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: Debates were fiercely oratorical; insults delivered from the floor often spilled into dawn honor duels (*lovagias ügy*). Procedural formulas (*Ügyrendi kérdésben kérek szót!*) required impeccable mastery of the rules of order.

sections.title: Patterns in Context
rows: Ügyrendi kérdésben kérek szót, Tisztelt Elnök Úr!
I ask for the floor on a point of order, Mr. Speaker!
I move for the amendment of the agenda...
Postponing the verification of the minutes...
